id: title:VojtechBartos:move the model catalogue into tasks and expose it over http

review.posthog_relevance: Architectural consolidation of Slack App LLM model fetching into the shared `products/tasks` backend, removing Slack-specific caching and gateway dependencies.
review.reason: The change removes Slack-app-specific implementation details for fetching and caching LLM models, replacing them with a shared `products/tasks` product catalogue. This establishes a single source of truth for model availability, reducing Slack-app maintenance burden and dependency on the gateway client. Tests and serialization are updated to support this new shared dependency. This

While the removal and delegation are clear, the full behavior and validation of the new shared implementation are not fully demonstrated in this chunk, preventing a definitive Tier 3 assessment. observations.behavior: Removes the Slack-app-specific LLM gateway model fetching and caching implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes the Slack-app-specific cached gateway model list, which relied on a 3s timeout and negative caching. This implementation is no longer present; the Slack app now depends on the shared tasks product catalogue.

observations.behavior: Replaces Slack-app-local model catalogue with shared tasks product catalogue; Slack-app no longer owns model definitions.
observations.posthog_connection: The Slack app now delegates model availability and presentation to the shared tasks product catalogue rather than maintaining its own gateway client and model parsing. This removes the Slack-app dependency on the gateway client and shared cache, and establishes a single source of truth for model presentation.

observations.behavior: Updates test assertions and imports to use the shared tasks product catalogue instead of Slack-app-local implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests are updated to use the shared tasks product catalogue, removing the dependency on the Slack-app-local implementation. This ensures tests remain compatible with the new architecture.
